# Naim Montazeri, Ph.D.

## Microbial Food Safety Scientist \| Predictive Modeling \| Risk Assessment

I am an Assistant Professor at the University of Florida with over 15 years of experience in microbial food safety (enteric bacteria and viruses), specializing in applied microbiology, sanitation validation, and risk-based decision-making. My work focuses on evaluating pathogen persistence, transfer, and inactivation in foods, agricultural systems, and food-contact surfaces to support product safety, regulatory compliance, and operational food safety programs.

I integrate experimental microbiology with data analysis and predictive modeling in R to quantify microbial behavior under realistic conditions and translate findings into actionable process controls, sanitation strategies, and validation frameworks. My experience includes EPA- and ASTM-aligned disinfection studies, environmental monitoring, agricultural water safety, and thermal process validation in high-risk food systems.

My work is cross-functional and application-driven, bridging microbiology, data analysis, and food safety systems to support industry, regulatory, and public health stakeholders.
:::

## Experience Snapshot

-   Assistant Professor, University of Florida — Microbial Food Safety (2018–present)\
-   Postdoctoral Researcher, North Carolina State University — Food Virology (2015–2018)\
-   Research Assistant, Louisiana State University — Food and Environmental Microbiology (2012–2015)\
-   Research Assistant, University of Alaska Fairbanks — Food Safety and Quality (2009–2011)\
-   Food Quality Assurance Intern, Pasargad Laboratory (2008–2009)

## Core Areas of Expertise

-   Sanitation validation and disinfection systems (EPA- and ASTM-aligned)
-   Applied microbiology and pathogen control (enteric bacteria and viruses)
-   Environmental monitoring and contamination control programs
-   Agricultural water safety and FSMA-aligned compliance strategies
-   Predictive microbiology and quantitative modeling (R-based)
-   Thermal processing and pathogen inactivation

## Research and Technical Portfolio

My work spans sanitation, agricultural water safety, thermal processing, and microbial persistence, with an emphasis on translating microbiological data into operational food safety decisions.
